varieties.name: Contender
varieties.traits: Bush habit, dark green stringless pods, germination 7-10 days
varieties.note: Marketed nationally (Starke Ayres home-garden range) with no stated regional restriction; the catalog's existing bush-bean spacing/timing figures already assume this general bush type. Breeding type (OP/hybrid) is not stated on the retail listing found, so left null rather than guessed — Contender is a long-established North American bush bean name and is commonly OP elsewhere, but that is not itself SA-sourced confirmation.

evidence.quote: produces tasty beans with dark green stringless pods, with germination of 7 to 10 days and maturity of 60 days
evidence.doc: Contender bush bean, Starke Ayres product page (via search snippet — page is JS-rendered and could not be fetched directly for a verbatim on-page quote)

varieties.name: Star 2000
varieties.traits: High-yielding bush habit, dark green stringless pods, germination 7-10 days
varieties.note: Same national, non-region-specific marketing as Contender; the two are presented by Starke Ayres as equivalent bush-bean choices.

evidence.quote: high-yielding bush beans with tasty, dark green stringless pods, also with germination of 7 to 10 days and maturity of 60 days
evidence.doc: Star 2000 bush bean, Starke Ayres product page (via search snippet — JS-rendered page, not directly fetchable)

gaps: No South African source found that differentiates green bean VARIETY choice by growing zone the way onions or carrots are differentiated — both named varieties are marketed nationally with only a season (spring/summer, full sun) attached, not a region. zoneAdvice is left empty rather than inventing an 8-zone spread; all zones list is carried only on the variety entries as 'this variety is not zone-restricted by the source', not as a sourced zone recommendation.

Both Starke Ayres product pages are JS-rendered single-page-app views; curl/WebFetch could only retrieve the page shell (nav menu), not the product description, so the quotes above come from a WebSearch tool summary of that page rather than a directly fetched verbatim quote. Flagged here rather than hidden.
OP vs hybrid status not stated for either cultivar in the source reached.
